scope: Read-only file metadata, selected path settings, identity IDs, plugin IDs/enabled flags, SQLite schema, aggregate counts, and open-handle metadata
config_parse_note: The JSON configuration was parsed in-process to extract only agent_workspace and appdata_dir. No other configuration values were inspected, emitted, or hashed.

sqlite.backup_api: SQLite online backup is qualified only in fictional fixtures; it was not run against private live databases.
sqlite.cross_database_consistency: Requires one application-level closed interval across all four databases and related files; independent online backups do not provide a cross-database transaction.

databases.role: shared default conversation and shared memory index
recovery, attempts, effects, and verification history

open_handle_observations.result: lsof showed PID 28093 open handles for the global conversation/memory database and testpilot2 memory database, including WAL/SHM files.

open_handle_observations.observed: later in the same read-only inventory
open_handle_observations.result: lsof on the workspace tree showed no database handles. PID 28093 still existed with the previously recorded start time.

sqlite.interpretation: Membership changed between observations. This does not establish that all connections are closed or that the service is idle.

filesystem.metadata: Paths, entry types, modes, sizes, ownership IDs, and timestamps were inspected. No file contents or hashes were read.
filesystem.backup_method: Include only identified application-owned paths in a closed-interval filesystem snapshot. Preserve POSIX modes and symlinks. Do not include run.log or OS metadata unless separately justified.

filesystem.metadata: Names, types, modes, sizes, and timestamps only. File contents were not read.
filesystem.backup_method: Include application-owned profile, identity, workspace, memory, scheduler, knowledge, skills/assets, and settings files in the same closed interval as the four database snapshots. Preserve symlinks, modes, and later user data during recovery.

filesystem.metadata: Membership, entry types, modes, sizes, and timestamps only. Configuration values and credential-bearing files were not read or hashed.
filesystem.backup_method: Capture the exact active CWD plugin state with the application-owned source/runtime state in the same closed interval. Do not assume the COW_DATA_DIR copy contains it.

identity_and_profiles.authority: workspace/agents/team.json plus each identity's workspace subtree
identity_and_profiles.backup_method: Closed-interval filesystem snapshot with mode and symlink preservation.

configuration_and_launch.runtime_configuration: config.json exists in primary_data; values not read. Backup method: protected application configuration copy in the closed interval; credential-specific approval and handling are required before copying private bytes.
configuration_and_launch.user_data: user_datas.pkl exists in primary_data; contents not read. Include only after explicit private-data copy approval.
configuration_and_launch.scheduler: workspace/scheduler and per-agent scheduler directories exist; entry contents not read. Runtime queue/state semantics remain unknown.
configuration_and_launch.profiles_and_assets: workspace profiles, Markdown files, knowledge, skills, system assets, and websites are present by path metadata; content-derived dependencies remain unknown.
configuration_and_launch.environment_and_dependencies: Current complete inherited environment, launch executable resolution, and dependency inventory were not read in this phase. Use fresh parent-owned live metadata; do not infer from prior receipts.

recovery_boundary.private_data_snapshot: Not performed; this task authorizes only design qualification.
recovery_boundary.actual_restore: Not performed or tested against live private data.
recovery_boundary.source_rollback: Returns code to a tested checkout only; it does not roll back database or file writes.
recovery_boundary.data_restore: Restore only to an isolated target after matching the closed-interval manifest. Before any replacement, reconcile post-snapshot user data and interrupted effects. Never overwrite newer legitimate state automatically.
recovery_boundary.external_effects: Recovery history is evidence to inspect, not a replay queue. No prior external effect may be replayed by this fixture or restore procedure.
recovery_boundary.approval_scope_for_private_copy: Requires separate explicit approval naming the source roots, private data classes, destination, access boundary, retention/deletion rule, operator, and restore rehearsal.

unknowns: Whether all current directories and files are represented by the observed path inventory.
Whether pending external or durable work exists outside the aggregate rows inspected.
Whether startup or shutdown changes these paths during a transition.
Whether the four live databases and files can be captured as one atomic snapshot while preserving later writes.
Whether candidate migrations and fallback behavior are safe for actual private live data.

path_resolution.saved_appdata_dir_resolution: appdata_dir is absent; config.py default is empty string. get_appdata_dir() resolves to get_data_root(); COW_DATA_DIR process binding is owned and freshly checked by parent.
path_resolution.effective_profiles_source: AgentRegistry.from_config derives absent workspace fields: default profile inherits agent_workspace; secondary profiles use <agent_workspace>/agents/<id>.
path_resolution.parent_environment_evidence: Parent harness freshly verified the process COW_DATA_DIR binding; this path inventory did not read the service environment.

config_json.classification: runtime configuration; only agent_workspace and appdata_dir were selected; other values were not inspected or emitted; back up only under approved private-data copy scope
config_json.method: capture file and required metadata in the closed-interval snapshot, protected destination

user_datas_pkl.method: approved protected file snapshot in the closed interval

workspace_copy.status: present but not the selected agent_workspace
workspace_copy.classification: unselected workspace tree with durable files and databases; retain as a separate source until owner reconciliation; never merge over the active workspace
workspace_copy.method: capture as its own metadata-preserving tree under approved private-data scope

sqlite_sync_repro.classification: unclassified reproduction directory with index.db plus WAL/SHM sidecars; not selected by config; preserve separately until owner classifies
sqlite_sync_repro.method: do not raw-copy SQLite; if retained, use an approved isolated online-backup copy and sidecar-independent snapshot

run_log.classification: mutable operational log; contents not read
run_log.method: exclude from data restore by default; preserve separately only if explicitly needed

ds_store.classification: OS directory metadata, not CowAgent durable state

profiles_and_identity.method: closed-interval filesystem capture with modes and symlinks; do not read or export contents outside explicit private-data approval

shared_skills.status: present; complete file metadata is in managed_filesystem_inventory.workspace
shared_skills.method: capture all files and symlinks; include in protected private-data copy

private_skill_overrides.status: absent; fallback to shared skills applies
private_skill_overrides.method: none for absent roots; recheck before any capture

scheduler.status: all three paths absent at inventory; legacy per-agent task paths also absent
scheduler.method: include paths if present at capture time; preserve primary and .bak as a coordinated pair; preserve recipient store separately but in same closed interval

transient_downloads.status: directory present with no contained files at inventory
transient_downloads.method: exclude transient items from durable snapshot by default; check for interrupted downloads within the known directory before transition

profile_prompt_and_identity_files.status: all entries and metadata are in the path inventory; contents not read
profile_prompt_and_identity_files.method: capture selected workspace identity/profile files in the protected closed-interval filesystem snapshot

conversation_and_memory_files.method: online-backup each active DB under one closed interval; include memory files and lock metadata only if present; do not copy DB sidecars raw

knowledge_files.status: all present entries and metadata are in the path inventory
knowledge_files.method: include as durable workspace files in the protected snapshot

system_assets.status: present files/directories are enumerated; contents not read
system_assets.method: include application-managed system and UI state with original modes/symlinks

published_outputs.status: directories exist; contained files are enumerated
published_outputs.method: include generated user-owned outputs with the workspace snapshot

source_mode_plugins.root: plugins/ under the service CWD; distinct from COW_DATA_DIR

plugin_manager_state.status: present; parsed only plugin IDs/enabled flags
plugin_manager_state.method: preserve current activation state with source selection; do not assume data-root backup covers it

role_catalog.method: preserve if mutable local state; otherwise restore from exact tested source revision; source version provenance not checked here

custom_role_directory.method: recheck before capture; if created, preserve its JSON files as operator-managed plugin data

banwords_list.status: absent; runtime treats missing list as empty
banwords_list.method: recheck before capture; if present, preserve as operator-managed plugin data

banwords_config.method: preserve with plugin state; contents and credential values not read

godcmd_config.method: recheck before capture; persisted admin state is in runtime config, not the plugin-local config

linkai_config.method: recheck before capture; no credential values read

temporary_password.status: process-memory only per source; no filesystem item identified

download_locations.status: plugins do not define a plugin-owned download directory; channel attachment/media staging resolves through active workspace tmp/; LinkAI may delete summarized input after use
download_locations.method: workspace tmp is transient; no temp files present at inventory

all_root_files.method: inventory metadata captured; preserve exact plugin state separately from user data when selecting source rollback

code_vs_mutable_data.classification: The inventory covers both plugin source files and local state files. It does not establish which files differ from the tested Git source revision.
code_vs_mutable_data.method: Use the exact tested source checkout for tracked code; preserve local mutable plugin files/config separately. Do not delete or overwrite ambiguous local files during source rollback.

dotenv.status: All four named .env paths are absent by lstat.

dependency_helpers.status: The manifest records each named source helper/dependency path as present or absent, with mode/owner/size. No dependency file contents or installed package versions were read.

python_runtime.method: re-establish exact resolved invocation and dependencies on candidate; keep external toolchain/dependencies outside these roots as separate prerequisites

environment_injected_secrets.status: process environment was not read by this inventory; parent owns fresh process identity
environment_injected_secrets.method: not a filesystem backup item; credentials require separate authority and must remain external

external_authority.cloud_provider_services_and_channel_acco: outside the three filesystem roots; credentials/session state are not read or copied; account-side effects require separate recovery/reconciliation
external_authority.OS_scheduler_keychain_and_network_settin: outside the three roots; no bindings or copies identified by this path inventory; preserve in place, require separate owner authority if change is proposed
